name: puppeteering
description: Mods for running a team of Claude Code agents.

plugins.name: puppet-monitor
plugins.description: See your team at work: an office in the browser and a band above the prompt.

plugins.name: puppet-teams
plugins.description: puppet-teams injects the agent-teams rules at session start, adds a short reminder to each work prompt in the main session, and sends an idle teammate back to its open task (TeammateIdle).
